fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (WMT) implemented more than 11,000 price reductions in Q2 (versus 7,200 in Q1), achieving 2.6% comparable sales growth in the U.S. and strong food market share.
fields.summary_ko.1: Walmart has risen 24.4% over the past 12 months, outpacing industry average of 23.2%, with forward P/E of 40.69x and projected current fiscal year revenue growth of 5.4% and EPS growth of 9.1%.
